Description (SPA): Identificador surrogate generado por SQLite para cada renglon de votos en formato largo.
Description (ENG): SQLite-generated surrogate identifier for each long-format vote row.
Notes: The analytical uniqueness is election_id + casilla_id + party_key.

Description (SPA): Concurso electoral al que pertenece el voto contabilizado.
Description (ENG): Election contest to which the counted vote row belongs.
Notes: Required for joining facts to dimensions and for separating repeated casilla identifiers across contests.

Description (SPA): Casilla o acta donde se registro la votacion de la opcion electoral.
Description (ENG): Polling station or acta where the vote total for the option was recorded.
Values / Domain: Values matching dim_casilla.casilla_id within the same election_id.
Notes: The warehouse does not define a direct SQLite FK to the composite dim_casilla key, but this is the intended logical join.

Description (SPA): Partido, coalicion u opcion electoral a la que corresponde el valor de votos.
Description (ENG): Party, coalition, or vote option to which the vote value corresponds.
Notes: Created by melting wide party columns into long format during cleaning.

Description (SPA): Votos emitidos para party_key en la casilla/acta y concurso especificos.
Description (ENG): Votes cast for party_key in the specified polling station/acta and contest.
Notes: This is the core long-format vote measure. It excludes null votes and non-registered candidate votes unless those are modeled as party_key in a source-specific clean file.

Description (SPA): Total de votos validos reportado por la fuente para la casilla/acta, cuando existe como campo agregado separado.
Description (ENG): Total valid votes reported by the source for the polling station/acta, when available as a separate aggregate field.
Notes: Mapped from VALIDOS in 2006. NULL for 1994, 2000, 2015, and 2021 additions because they do not provide that aggregate in the loaded schema.

Description (SPA): Total de votos nulos reportado por la fuente para la casilla/acta.
Description (ENG): Total null votes reported by the source for the polling station/acta.
Notes: Mapped from NULOS, VN, NO_VOTOS_NULOS, or VOTOS NULOS depending on cycle normalization.

Description (SPA): Total de votos para candidaturas no registradas reportado por la fuente.
Description (ENG): Total votes for non-registered candidates reported by the source.
Notes: Mapped from NO_REG, CAND_NO_REGIS, CNR, NO_REGISTRADOS, or CANDIDATO/A NO REGISTRADO/A depending on cycle normalization.

Description (SPA): Total de votos de la casilla/acta reportado o calculado por el archivo limpio del ciclo.
Description (ENG): Total votes for the polling station/acta as reported or calculated by the cycle clean file.
Notes: Mapped from TOTAL, TOTAL_VOTOS, or TOTAL_VOTOS_CALCULADOS depending on cycle. It is repeated on each party_key row for the same casilla.

Description (SPA): Marca de tiempo de insercion generada por SQLite.
